kinds.d: Plant drink made by blending oats with water and enzymes; the most popular dairy-free milk for coffee.
Plant drink made from soaked, ground and strained soya beans; the highest-protein common plant milk.
Plant drink made from ground almonds and water, usually fortified; low in protein and calories.
Coconut drink sold as a milk alternative; coconut milk and cream for cooking are in Pantry Staples.
Plant drink made from milled rice and water; naturally sweet, low in protein, suited to nut and soya allergies.
Plant drink made from yellow-pea protein with oil and water; protein close to cow's milk.

kinds.a: nut milk · seed milk · walnut drink · peanut drink · hemp milk · cashew milk · hazelnut milk
kinds.d: Plant drink made from nuts or seeds other than almond, such as cashew, hazelnut, walnut, peanut or hemp.
r: Rude Health nut and tiger nut drinks

brands.d: Malmö oat-drink maker founded by food scientist Rickard Öste on Lund University research; first commercial oat milk.
Ghent plant-based food company owned by Danone; soya, almond, hazelnut, cashew, rice, oat and coconut drinks.
American dairy-substitute brand from WhiteWave Foods of Boulder, now owned by Danone; soy, almond, cashew, coconut and oat milks.
Californian plant-based beverage maker founded by Greg Steltenpohl; started in almond milk, then oat and coconut.
London coffee-and-oat-milk brand set up by Stuart Forsyth, Jonathan Chiu and Will Rixon, best known for barista oat.
Hong Kong soy-milk pioneer founded by Lo Kwee-seong; also makes tofu and the Vita drinks range.
British cereal and dairy-free drinks brand, making short-ingredient nut, oat and tiger-nut drinks since 2013.
Emeryville, California maker of pea-protein milk, half & half and yoghurt, founded by Adam Lowry and Neil Renninger.
Malmö pea-protein milk brand known for zebra-striped packs; Original, Unsweetened, Chocolate and Barista.
Sacramento almond growers' cooperative, maker of Almond Breeze almond milk.
Coconut-based dairy-free drink brand owned by First Grade International Ltd.

notes: Merged Walnut drink and Peanut drink into Nut & seed drink (types cashew, hazelnut, walnut, peanut, hemp, macadamia, tiger nut, sesame, blend). New kinds Rice drink and Pea drink sourced to Wikipedia (Rice milk, Pea milk). Soyog range kept only on Soy drink (Soyog is a Chinese soy-milk brand per a retailer listing); removed from Oat drink. Trimmed SKU/regional noise: ButtaNutt Oat Milk, Country Delight Oat Beverage, Feichangmai Oat Milk, Natural One Bebida de Aveia (oat), Joyoung Soy Milk (Joyoung is chiefly a soymilk-maker appliance brand) and Vivi Soy Milk (soy). Oat models are now the olive magazine expert oat-milk taste-test winners plus Consumer Reports' top non-soy plant milk (Planet Oat); Silk Unsweet Organic Soymilk is Consumer Reports' top-rated plant milk. Vamino maker normalised to Green Spot (Vitamilk's maker). Koko country and Sproud founding year left blank (not confirmed). No register entries for Planet Oat, MOMA, Glebe Farm, Jörd, Plenish, Malk, Lactasoy, Mighty Society or Imagine Foods (brand pages not retrieved). No traditions: plant drinks have no relevant artisan tradition (doujiang could be one later).
